method.synchronization: jax.block_until_ready after every measured full-state call
method.source_hash_method: Sorted jaxprop/**/*.py relative POSIX path, NUL, exact bytes, NUL; SHA256.
method.mixture_model: Fixed mass fractions, additive specific volume/enthalpy/entropy, common pressure and temperature. No molecular entropy-of-mixing term.
method.comparable_binary_scope: Legacy FluidMix scalar HP vs common Fluid constructor using source components. Batch16 counterpart is explicitly legacy scalar-loop plus public FluidState.stack vs new broadcast call.
method.intentional_physics_changes: Old mass-averaged cv and reported mass-weighted isentropic compressibility/bulk modulus are inconsistent with the retained common-p/T model. New values are checked against cp-T*alpha^2/(rho*kT), kS=1/(rho*a^2), KS=rho*a^2. No old/new ratio assigned to these changed outputs.
method.missing_old_capabilities: Working native component-object, PT/PS, JAX binary implementations were unavailable. New-only complete-state rows receive no legacy speedup ratio.
method.numerical_sampling: All 19 preserved binary fields at 12 scalar source states and all 16 source-batch rows; all enabled pure-control fields except unavailable surface tension at one scalar and 16 batch rows. New-only round trips check all 27 enabled properties with paired NaNs for unavailable fields.
